session.title: Session 8 - Personal Feelings, Opinions & Experiences (Adj)
session.classInfo: CCBE Galle Branch • TUE/THU/IPET015 • Ms. Sumodya Sewmini (Lecturer in Charge)

words.m: Feeling fear or anxiety; frightened.
words.s: She was never afraid of speaking in front of a large audience.

words.m: Greatly surprised; astonished.
words.s: We were amazed by how quickly the students learned the new words.

words.m: Causing laughter and providing entertainment.
words.s: The lecturer told an amusing story at the start of the lesson.

words.s: He felt annoyed when he missed the morning bus by ten seconds.

words.s: Many students feel anxious right before an important examination.

words.s: He felt ashamed after forgetting his best friend's birthday.

words.s: The view from the top of the mountain was truly awesome.

words.s: We followed the wooden signpost pointing towards the village.

words.s: The astronauts travelled to the moon inside a silver spaceship.

words.s: She packed her warm winter clothes into a large blue suitcase.

words.s: No motor vehicle is allowed to enter the pedestrian shopping street.
